why: By forbidding cuts on function-word boundaries the scorer stopped splitting off short determiners/auxiliaries and instead attached them to neighboring content, which moved many cut positions; this helped some mid-length pieces (≤5 bin +0.025) but harmed very-short pieces (≤3 bin −0.0314) and produced more overall declines than gains (196 worse vs 150 better). For example, en_us_1465 shows the cut before 'the' was removed (now 'visit the historic city'), while en_us_1427 illustrates a mid-length improvement where joining reduced contradiction.
lesson: Do not apply a blanket prohibition on relocating cuts to function-word boundaries — the change helps some bins (≈≤5) but hurts very-short pieces (≤3), so later revisions should avoid uniform application that degrades the smallest-latency buckets.
